basis_or_scenario: single 20 K cryocooler, no pre-cooling, ortho-to-para conversion included; comparison bullet on the mass-assumptions slide
notes: verbatim: 'Single 20 K cryocooler requires 35 kW input power and 85 m2 radiator'. Upstream's quoted figure.

basis_or_scenario: with production margin; parenthetical sizes the plant at ~10 t/yr total propellant, ~1.6 t/yr LH2
notes: verbatim: 'Liquefaction rate of 0.3 kg/hr of hydrogen (~10 ton/yr total prop, ~1.6 ton/yr LH2) with production margin'. Upstream derives its O2 rate 0.96 kg/hr from this same parenthetical (MR-consistent).
verbatim: 'Input power reduced from 34 kW to 19 kW at 150 K radiator temperature'. Deck's own baseline number here is 34 kW vs the comparison bullet's 35 kW - both printed in one deck.

basis_or_scenario: 150 K radiator + intermediate cryocooler at ~15% Carnot; radiator areas 40-50 m2
notes: verbatim: 'Even with 15% Carnot intermediate cryocooler, cut input power by 70%'. This is upstream's 'cut by up to 3x' (divide-by-three of the baseline energy).
verbatim: 'System oxygen liquefaction system would require < 2 kW'. Upstream bounds O2 at <=1.79 kWh per kg propellant using its p4-derived 0.96 kg/hr.

basis_or_scenario: double-sided vertical radiator, GRC Compass Team system-level analysis; extrapolated to all temperatures
notes: verbatim: 'Double-sided vertical radiator – 3.9 kg/kW heat rejection'. The deck adds 'Ignore cryocooler mass' immediately after - matching spacecost's note that this floor leaves out the electrolyser and cryocoolers.
Upstream's comment prints this as '39 to 117 kWh/kg H2' with the low end at one-third of baseline; x(1/7) gives their 5.56-16.7 kWh per kg propellant band term.
